written.headline: Bower Rangers stuns 2nd-place madmaxwellog49
lead: Nobody had Jared in this one. Sitting 12th coming in, he took down 2nd-place Max, 148.12–123.34. Jared Goff kept Max in it (271 passing yards, 3 TD; 1 carries for 1 yards and 1 TD). First meeting, first blood to Jared.

Mike had the week's best score at 171.88, while jjssrrgg brought up the rear with 77.94. Puka Nacua was the best starter in the league: 2 carries for 9 yards; 17 catches on 24 targets for 138 yards and 1 TD.
Jorguss sits atop the standings at 4-1. Lake has won 3 straight. jjssrrgg has lost 3 straight.
Off the wire, Jared Goff gave Max 28.94 points this week.
Last week's front page: “Jared’s Big Papa stuns 2nd-place madmaxwellog49.” The league has moved on, mostly.

6.headline: Let Him Cook  dispatches jjssrrgg, 108.70–77.94

written.subhead: Chris won 124.06–62.12, the most lopsided game of the week.

written.headline: mikhawk stuns 2nd-place madmaxwellog49
lead: Caleb Williams was back, and Max noticed: 305 passing yards, 1 TD; 4 carries for 3 yards in his first game after missing 3 games with a Hamstring injury. Final: Jackson 121.14, Max 104.90. Kenneth Walker kept Max in it (19 carries for 128 yards and 2 TD; 2 catches on 3 targets for 11 yards). First meeting, first blood to Jackson.

Nobody scored more than Austin Mick's 137.76, while jjssrrgg brought up the rear with 45.12. Christian McCaffrey was the best starter in the league: 16 carries for 64 yards and 2 TD; 9 catches on 10 targets for 53 yards; 1 lost fumble.
Jorguss sits atop the standings at 5-1. Lake has won 4 straight. Connor has won 3 straight.
Off the wire, Germie Bernard gave Lake 25.70 points this week.
Last week's front page: “Bower Rangers stuns 2nd-place madmaxwellog49.” The league has moved on, mostly.

body: Spare a thought for Silverhammer. 132.30 points would have beaten 11 of 13 teams this week, and it still went down as a loss.
